title: Accident and health or sickness insurance policy defined.
bodyText: The term, policy of accident and health or sickness insurance, includes any policy or contract covering the class of insurance described in section 431:1-205.
bodyHtml: §431:10A-102  Accident and health or sickness insurance policy defined.  The term, policy of accident and health or sickness insurance, includes any policy or contract covering the class of insurance described in section 431:1-205. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2; am L 2002, c 155, §50]
